guide.description: Turn your beatboxing into drums and practice with demos, comparisons and scores.

controls.action: Say B, Pf and t into the microphone to trigger kick, snare and hats.
Switch to Sound Lab, press K3 for a demo, then imitate it and check your match.
In Rhythm mode, start practice: count four beats, play two bars, then see your score.
Cycle Transform, Sound Lab and Rhythm.
Microphone sensitivity: raise it for missed hits, lower it for false triggers.
Output volume.
Reset that encoder to its default value.
Switch directly to a mode.
Choose Classic, 808, Lo-fi or Vocal kit.
Mix in your dry voice.
Toggle the metronome.
Mute while held.
Listen to a drum sound.
Choose B, Pf, K, t or ts.
Play a demo, then imitate the sound.
Compare your last recording with the demo.
Choose a sound.
Choose a rhythm pattern.
Adjust tempo in BPM.
Start or stop the demo rhythm.
Start or stop practice; see the step results and score at the end.

sections.title: Audio and recognition
sections.text: Demos are synthesized beatbox sounds, not human recordings. Recognition compares the first 8 ms of each sound. Use headphones to avoid speaker retriggering. Practicing in Sound Lab improves recognition of your voice in Transform.

sections.title: Saved settings
sections.text: Mode, kit, parameters, selected sound and pattern, tempo, learned voice features and best scores save automatically. Exiting releases the microphone.
